name: Plex
description: UNVERIFIED and deliberately minimal: SMTC buttons and PC volume only. Plex's keyboard shortcut page (support.plex.tv) could not be read, so no Plex key is guessed. The Plex Player API (/player/playback/..., documented in the plex-media-player wiki) is not used: its port and whether current Plex apps still expose it are unconfirmed. Whether Plex registers SMTC also needs checking on a real PC. Keys and local HTTP will be added once verified.
